items.summary: A study found that using artificial intelligence for as little as 10 minutes can reduce one's perseverance in challenging tasks, highlighting the potential psychological impacts of relying on technology. This broader impact suggests that reliance on AI might undermine fundamental human skills needed for sustained effort and problem-solving.
